jobs.title: Manager, Accounting & Reporting
jobs.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

The Manager, Accounting & Reporting – Revenue, leads a high-performing team responsible for end-to-end revenue accounting, ensuring compliance with IFRS (especially IFRS 15) and Alcon policies. The role delivers timely, accurate revenue reporting, maintains a SOX-compliant control environment (including proper separation of duties), and partners with cross-functional stakeholders to provide financial insight and drive business value. The Manager also champions process automation, talent development, and a culture of continuous improvement in support of Alcon’s broader business and DEI priorities.

In this role, a typical day will include:

Revenue Accounting & Reporting

• Oversee revenue accounting activities, ensuring compliance with IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards and seamless integration with Alcon’s internal accounting policies and procedures.

• Review contracts with customers and ensure accurate recognition of revenue and management of associated balance sheet positions, including accruals, rebates, deductions, trade receivables, and other related accounts.

• Lead a timely and precise month-end close process for all revenue-related areas, including preparation and review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and thorough variance analyses.

• Review and validate revenue reporting within Alcon’s consolidation systems and other management reporting systems, ensuring consistency and alignment with both IFRS requirements and the Alcon Accounting Manual.

• Proactively monitor the completeness and accuracy of revenue data, collaborating cross-functionally to resolve discrepancies and ensure the integrity of financial information.

Close, Controls & Compliance

• Ensure full compliance with IFRS, the Alcon Accounting Manual (AMA), and internal control requirements—including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) regulations where applicable—by proactively monitoring and implementing relevant standards and policies.

• Maintain and continuously enhance a robust internal control environment over revenue-related processes, ensuring comprehensive documentation of all key controls, procedures, and workflows in alignment with best practices.

• Provide proactive support for internal and external audits by preparing thorough documentation, timely explanations, and detailed analytical support regarding revenue accounting matters, thereby facilitating efficient and effective audit processes.

• Lead the timely identification, resolution, and remediation of reconciliation items to ensure accurate financial reporting and sustained compliance with internal and external requirements.

Business Partnering & Coordination

• Foster strong collaboration with key stakeholders—including Local Finance, Business Planning & Analysis (BPA), Commercial teams, Consolidation & Reporting, and AGS—leveraging strong business knowledge to ensure accurate accounting treatment and comprehensive understanding of revenue drivers across multiple time zones and countries.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for revenue-related accounting matters, providing expert guidance and well-substantiated accounting conclusions while managing intricate stakeholder relationships in a global context.

• Drive alignment between financial reporting and business performance insights by proactively facilitating communication and knowledge sharing among diverse stakeholders, ensuring clarity and consistency across geographical regions.

Process Improvement & Projects

• Provide hands-on leadership in identifying and driving process improvement initiatives focused on increasing efficiency, automation, and standardization

• Collaborate cross-functionally to lead or actively participate in projects designed to enhance data quality, improve reporting accuracy, and accelerate closing timelines.

• Champion digitalization by supporting the implementation of new systems, tools, and accounting requirements, proactively adapting processes and reporting to align with evolving standards.

Team Leadership & Support

• Empower and coach senior associates to achieve their full potential, fostering professional growth and accountability within the team.

• Strategically coordinate and prioritize team activities, ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of high-quality outputs that meet organizational expectations and deadlines.

• Champion a culture of collaboration

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO ALCON:

Education & Experience :

• Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field;

• Chartered Accountant or equivalent international certification preferred (e.g., CPA, ACCA).

• Solid accounting and reporting experience within multinational organizations and/or within accounting audit firm with a strong record in accounting revenue

• Previous exposure to SOX, IFRS essential

Technical skills :

• Strong knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting principles

• Solid knowledge of revenue processes and internal controls

• Experience with SAP and reporting tools (e.g., FCRS, APMR)

• Proficiency in Excel and data analysis

• Ability to work with large datasets and ensure data accuracy

Soft skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work cross functional and multicultural teams, with a collaborative and agile mindset.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership abilities.

• Proactive mindset with focus on continuous improvement

• Ability to prioritize

• Team-oriented with leadership and coaching capabilities

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:
● Manage your own workload and schedule while hitting your set targets
● Collaborate with teammates to share best practices and learnings as work evolves
● See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities

Con più di 25.000 associati, innovare senza paura, il progresso del campione, e agire rapidamente per influenzare la salute degli occhi globale. Insieme, facciamo la differenza nella vita dei nostri pazienti e clienti. Sei pronto ad unirsi a noi?

Il Manager, Accounting & Reporting – Revenue, guida un team altamente performante responsabile della contabilità dei ricavi end-to-end, garantendo il rispetto delle policy IFRS (specialmente IFRS 15) e Alcon. Il ruolo offre report dei ricavi tempestivi e accurati, mantiene un ambiente di controllo conforme alla SOX (compresa la corretta separazione dei doveri), e partner con parti interessate interfunzionali per fornire informazioni finanziarie e valorizzare le imprese. Il Manager sostiene anche l’automazione del processo, lo sviluppo di talenti e una cultura di miglioramento continuo a sostegno delle priorità aziendali e del DEI di Alcon.

In questo ruolo, una giornata tipica comprenderà:

Revenue Accounting & Reporting

• Superare le attività di contabilità delle entrate, garantire il rispetto degli standard di riconoscimento delle entrate IFRS 15 e l’integrazione senza soluzione di continuità con le politiche e le procedure contabili interne di Alcon.

• Contratti di revisione con i clienti e garantire il riconoscimento accurato delle entrate e della gestione delle posizioni del bilancio associate, compresi gli accruamenti, gli sconti, le deduzioni, i crediti commerciali e altri conti correlati.

• Condurre un processo di fine mese tempestivo e preciso per tutte le aree correlate ai ricavi, tra cui la preparazione e la revisione delle entrate, le conciliazioni dei conti e le analisi approfondite delle variazioni.

• Verificare e convalidare il reporting dei ricavi all’interno dei sistemi di consolidamento di Alcon e di altri sistemi di reporting gestionale, garantendo coerenza e allineamento con i requisiti IFRS e il Manuale di Accounting Alcon.

• Proattivamente monitora la completezza e l'accuratezza dei dati di reddito, collaborando trasversalmente per risolvere le discrepanze e garantire l'integrità delle informazioni finanziarie.

Chiudi, Controlli e conformità

• Assicurare la piena conformità con IFRS, il Manuale di Contabilità Alcon (AMA), e i requisiti di controllo interno, compresi i regolamenti Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) laddove applicabile, monitorando e implementando proattivamente standard e politiche pertinenti.

• Mantenere e migliorare continuamente un ambiente di controllo interno robusto sui processi legati ai ricavi, garantendo una documentazione completa di tutti i controlli, le procedure e i flussi di lavoro in linea con le migliori pratiche.

• Fornire un supporto proattivo per gli audit interni ed esterni preparando una documentazione approfondita, spiegazioni tempestive e un supporto analitico dettagliato in materia di contabilità delle entrate, facilitando così processi di audit efficienti ed efficaci.

• Condurre l'identificazione tempestiva, la risoluzione e la bonifica degli elementi di riconciliazione per garantire un'accurata rendicontazione finanziaria e una costante conformità ai requisiti interni ed esterni.

Partner aziendale e coordinamento

• Promuovere una forte collaborazione con i principali stakeholder, tra cui finanza locale, pianificazione aziendale e analisi (BPA), team commerciali, consolidamento e reporting, e AGS, con una forte conoscenza aziendale per garantire un trattamento contabile accurato e una comprensione completa dei driver di reddito in più fusi orari e paesi.

• Servire come punto di contatto principale per le questioni contabili relative ai ricavi, fornire una guida esperta e conclusioni contabili ben motivate, gestendo intricate relazioni con gli stakeholder in un contesto globale.

• Migliorare l'allineamento tra rendicontazione finanziaria e intuizioni sulle prestazioni aziendali facilitando proattivamente la condivisione di comunicazioni e conoscenze tra i diversi stakeholder, garantendo chiarezza e coerenza nelle regioni geografiche.

Miglioramento dei processi e progetti

• Fornire leadership hands-on per identificare e migliorare il processo di guida init

Der Manager, Accounting & Reporting – Revenue, leitet ein leistungsstarkes Team, das für die End-to-End-Umsatzrechnung verantwortlich ist und die Einhaltung der IFRS (insbesondere IFRS 15) und der Alcon-Richtlinien gewährleistet. Die Rolle liefert eine zeitnahe, genaue Umsatzberichterstattung, unterhält eine SOX-konforme Kontrollumgebung (einschließlich einer ordnungsgemäßen Aufgabentrennung) und arbeitet mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern zusammen, um finanzielle Einblicke zu liefern und den Geschäftswert zu steigern. Der Manager setzt sich auch für Prozessautomatisierung, Talententwicklung und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ein, um die breiteren Geschäfts- und DEI-Prioritäten von Alcon zu unterstützen.

In dieser Rolle wird ein typischer Tag beinhalten:

Revenue Accounting & Reporting

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Umsatzrechnungsaktivitäten, stellen Sie die Einhaltung der IFRS 15 Umsatzrechnungsstandards und die nahtlose Integration in die internen Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze und -verfahren von Alcon sicher.

• Überprüfung von Verträgen mit Kunden und Gewährleistung einer genauen Erfassung der Einnahmen und Verwaltung der damit verbundenen Bilanzpositionen, einschließlich Periodenabgrenzungen, Rabatten, Abzügen, Handelsforderungen und anderen damit verbundenen Konten.

• Führen Sie einen zeitnahen und präzisen Monatsabschlussprozess für alle umsatzbezogenen Bereiche, einschließlich der Vorbereitung und Überprüfung von Zeitschrifteneinträgen, Kontoabstimmungen und gründlichen Varianzanalysen.

• Überprüfung und Validierung der Umsatzberichterstattung in den Konsolidierungssystemen und anderen Management-Reporting-Systemen von Alcon, um die Konsistenz und Übereinstimmung mit den IFRS-Anforderungen und dem Alcon Accounting Manual sicherzustellen.

• Proaktive Überwachung der Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Umsatzdaten, funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, um Diskrepanzen zu beheben und die Integrität der Finanzinformationen zu gewährleisten.

Close, Controls & Compliance

• Gewährleistung der vollständigen Einhaltung der IFRS, des Alcon Accounting Manual (AMA) und der internen Kontrollanforderungen – einschließlich gegebenenfalls der Vorschriften von Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) – durch proaktive Überwachung und Umsetzung der einschlägigen Standards und Richtlinien.

• Pflegen und verbessern Sie kontinuierlich eine robuste interne Kontrollumgebung für umsatzbezogene Prozesse und gewährleisten Sie eine umfassende Dokumentation aller wichtigen Kontrollen, Verfahren und Workflows in Übereinstimmung mit Best Practices.

• Proaktive Unterstützung für interne und externe Audits durch die Erstellung gründlicher Dokumentationen, rechtzeitiger Erklärungen und detaillierter analytischer Unterstützung in Bezug auf Umsatzrechnungsfragen, wodurch effiziente und effektive Auditprozesse erleichtert werden.

• Führen Sie die rechtzeitige Identifizierung, Abwicklung und Behebung von Abgleichsposten, um eine genaue Finanzberichterstattung und eine nachhaltige Einhaltung interner und externer Anforderungen zu gewährleisten.

Business Partnering & Koordination

• Förderung einer starken Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Stakeholdern - einschließlich lokaler Finanzen, Business Planning & Analysis (BPA), kaufmännischer Teams, Konsolidierung & Reporting und AGS - durch die Nutzung solider Geschäftskenntnisse, um eine genaue Buchhaltungsbehandlung und ein umfassendes Verständnis der Umsatztreiber in mehreren Zeitzonen und Ländern zu gewährleisten.

• Dienen Sie als primäre Anlaufstelle für umsatzbezogene Buchhaltungsangelegenheiten und bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung und fundierte Schlussfolgerungen im Rechnungswesen, während Sie komplizierte Stakeholder-Beziehungen in einem globalen Kontext verwalten.

• Förderung der Abstimmung zwischen Finanzberichterstattung und Erkenntnissen zur Geschäftsleistung durch proaktive Erleichterung der Kommunikation und des Wissensaustauschs zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen und Gewährleistung von Klarheit und Konsistenz in den geografischen Regionen.

Prozessverbesserung & Projekte

• Geben Sie praktische Führung bei der Identifizierung und Förderung der Prozessverbesserung init

Le gestionnaire, Comptabilité & Reporting – Revenus, dirige une équipe hautement performante chargée de la comptabilité des revenus de bout en bout, assurant le respect des normes IFRS (notamment IFRS 15) et Alcon. Le rôle consiste à produire des rapports exacts et opportuns sur les recettes, à maintenir un environnement de contrôle conforme aux normes SOX (y compris une séparation adéquate des tâches) et à établir des partenariats avec des intervenants interfonctionnels afin de fournir des renseignements financiers et de stimuler la valeur opérationnelle. Le gestionnaire défend également l'automatisation des processus, le développement des talents et une culture d'amélioration continue à l'appui des priorités plus larges d'Alcon et de DEI.

Dans ce rôle, une journée typique comprendra:

Comptabilité des recettes et rapports

• Surveiller les activités de comptabilité des recettes, assurer le respect des normes de comptabilisation des recettes d'IFRS 15 et s'intégrer de manière transparente aux méthodes et procédures comptables internes d'Alcon.

• Examiner les contrats avec les clients et veiller à la comptabilisation exacte des recettes et à la gestion des positions de bilan connexes, y compris les charges à payer, les remboursements, les déductions, les créances commerciales et les autres comptes connexes.

• Diriger un processus de clôture de fin de mois précis et en temps opportun pour tous les secteurs liés aux recettes, y compris la préparation et l'examen des entrées de journaux, le rapprochement des comptes et des analyses approfondies des écarts.

• Examiner et valider les rapports sur les recettes au sein des systèmes de consolidation d'Alcons et d'autres systèmes de rapports de gestion, en assurant la cohérence et l'alignement avec les exigences des IFRS et avec le Manuel de comptabilité d'Alcon.

• Surveiller de façon proactive l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude des données sur les revenus, collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle pour résoudre les écarts et assurer l'intégrité de l'information financière.

Fermeture, contrôles et conformité

• Assurer le plein respect des IFRS, du Manuel de comptabilité Alcon (AMA) et des exigences en matière de contrôle interne, y compris les règlements Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), le cas échéant, en surveillant et en appliquant de manière proactive les normes et politiques pertinentes.

• Maintenir et améliorer continuellement un environnement de contrôle interne solide sur les processus liés aux recettes, en assurant la documentation complète de tous les contrôles, procédures et flux de travail clés, conformément aux pratiques exemplaires.

• Fournir un soutien proactif pour les vérifications internes et externes en préparant des documents détaillés, des explications en temps opportun et un soutien analytique détaillé concernant les questions de comptabilité des recettes, facilitant ainsi des processus de vérification efficaces et efficients.

• Diriger l'identification, la résolution et l'assainissement en temps opportun des éléments de rapprochement afin d'assurer l'exactitude des rapports financiers et le respect continu des exigences internes et externes.

Partenariat d'affaires et coordination

• Favoriser une solide collaboration avec les principaux intervenants, y compris les finances locales, la planification et l'analyse des activités, les équipes commerciales, la consolidation et l'établissement de rapports et l'AGS, en mettant à profit de solides connaissances commerciales pour assurer un traitement comptable précis et une compréhension complète des facteurs de revenus dans plusieurs fuseaux horaires et pays.

• Servir de point de contact principal pour les questions comptables liées aux recettes, fournir des conseils d'experts et des conclusions comptables bien étayées tout en gérant des relations complexes avec les parties prenantes dans un contexte mondial.

• Favoriser l'harmonisation entre l'information financière et le rendement opérationnel en facilitant proactivement la communication et le partage des connaissances entre les divers intervenants, en assurant la clarté et la cohérence entre les régions géographiques.

Amélioration des processus et projets

• Fournir un leadership pratique dans l'identification et l'amélioration des processus

With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

The International Accounting and Reporting Director is a pivotal senior finance leadership role responsible for driving the strategic direction and strengthening governance of accounting and financial reporting across International markets. This role provides enterprise-wide oversight of IFRS and Alcon policy application, leading complex accounting decisions and ensuring consistency, transparency, and control at scale. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior regional and global stakeholders, the Director shapes key business decisions and drives financial integrity. With strong visibility to executive leadership, this position plays a critical role in advancing reporting excellence, driving digital transformation, and building organizational capability. It is a key successor role within the International Finance leadership pipeline, with significant ownership and influence over high-impact financial outcomes.

Leadership Expectations:

• Lead the evolution of FRA function into an International organization, scaling the team and operating model to support the growth of the region.

• Own and elevate stakeholder experience, delivering high-quality, reliable accounting outcomes and balance sheet reviews.

• Act as the single point of accountability (for Global Technical Accounting, International FRA Head, Consolidations and Reporting function) for key accounting and reporting decisions and risk management across regions.

• Champion digital transformation, advancing automation and innovation in accounting and reporting.

• Strengthen controller capability, partnering with regions to build a high-performing, future-ready finance talent bench.

In this role, a typical day will include:

• International Accounting & Reporting

• Lead quarterly International Balance Sheet reviews with the CFO and Head of FRA, driving alignment on key risks, judgments, and actions.

• Own key International Accounting processes and drive harmonization of accounting practices across regions.

• Conduct deep-dive reviews of critical balance sheet and income statement areas, identifying opportunities to enhance consistency, transparency, and control.

• Align regional processes to support growth, ensuring effective coordination with Regional teams, Global functions, Consolidations and Reporting, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Risk, Controls & Governance

• Lead and coordinate resolution of complex and unusual accounting topics, partnering with C&R and Global Technical Accounting to ensure alignment.

• Shape regional revenue recognition positions and drive alignment with Global Technical Accounting.

• Establish a robust risk identification and governance framework, ensuring timely escalation, resolution, and mitigation of key accounting risks across markets.

• Key partner to the Internal Controls function to strengthen controls across International markets.

• Champion Digital Transformation

• Key member of governance body within FRA International to implement responsible usage of automation and artificial intelligence capabilities. Embed a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and technologies to modernize the FRA function.

• Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate processes and leverage AI in core accounting and reporting activities.

• Lead implementation of digital initiatives by partnering with internal teams and external consultants, ensuring measurable efficiency and quality gains.

• People & Organizational Leadership

• Partner with regional FRA/Finance leaders to build a high-performing controller community, focusing on quality, accountability, and business partnership.

• Demonstrate influence (with or without authority) by design and delivering targeted initiatives such as IFRS training, technical workshops, and knowledge-sharing forums to enhance capability and engagement.

• Travel Expectations:

• Travel on a need basis. Current estimate: 30% travel in Year 1 with an expectation of reduced travel in the future.

Key Success Factors:

• Shape and influence critical accounting judgments, ensuring strong alignment with Global functions and Consolidations & Reporting (C&R).

• Drive consistent and robust accounting positions across the region, with particular focus on revenue recognition and key FSLIs.

• Lead the effective and responsible adoption of digital initiatives, driving scalable improvements while actively contributing to cross-functional transformation efforts.

• Own and lead International Balance Sheet governance, facilitating high-quality discussions with senior stakeholders to proactively identify risks and drive actions.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

Education:

• Chartered Accountant or CPA is a must.

Languages:

• Fluent English + other languages (mandarin or Japanese) a plus

Experience:

• Deep accounting expertise and business judgment, with 15+ years of experience across accounting, finance, internal controls, or advisory roles, and strong command of IFRS and complex accounting frameworks.

• Proven ability to shape and influence senior stakeholders, driving focused discussions with Finance leadership and enabling meaningful policy, structural business changes within the organization.

• Strong technical foundation with global perspective, including experience in Big 4 audit and/or Technical Accounting, and operating effectively within complex, multinational matrix environments.

• Track record of building high-performing teams, with demonstrated success in talent development, organizational leadership, and leading through transformation and change.

• Digital and systems acumen, with proficiency in SAP and other ERP platforms, and the ability to leverage technology to enhance efficiency, control, and insight.

• Exceptional communication and leadership presence, enabling effective collaboration, clear articulation of complex topics, and influence at all levels of the organization.

L'International Accounting and Reporting Director è un ruolo chiave di leadership di finanza senior responsabile della guida della direzione strategica e del rafforzamento della governance della contabilità e della rendicontazione finanziaria sui mercati internazionali. Questo ruolo fornisce la supervisione a livello aziendale dell'applicazione politica IFRS e Alcon, determinando decisioni contabili complesse e garantendo coerenza, trasparenza e controllo su scala. Essendo un consulente di fiducia per gli stakeholder regionali e globali senior, il Direttore elabora le principali decisioni aziendali e guida l'integrità finanziaria. Con una forte visibilità alla leadership esecutiva, questa posizione gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere la segnalazione di eccellenza, la guida della trasformazione digitale e la capacità organizzativa di costruzione. Si tratta di un ruolo chiave successore all'interno della direzione International Finance pipeline, con una significativa proprietà e influenza sui risultati finanziari ad alto impatto.

Aspetti di leadership:

• Guidare l'evoluzione della funzione FRA in un'organizzazione internazionale, scalare il team e il modello operativo per sostenere la crescita della regione.

• Avere ed elevare l'esperienza degli stakeholder, offrendo risultati contabili di alta qualità, affidabili e recensioni dei bilanci.

• Atto come unico punto di responsabilità (per Global Technical Accounting, International FRA Head, Consolidations and Reporting function) per le principali decisioni di contabilità e reporting e gestione dei rischi in tutte le regioni.

• Trasformazione digitale campione, automazione e innovazione in contabilità e reporting.

• Rafforzare la capacità del controller, collaborando con le regioni per costruire una panchina di talento finanza di alto livello e pronta per il futuro.

In questo ruolo, una giornata tipica comprenderà:

• Contabilità internazionale & Reporting

• Equilibrio internazionale di piombo trimestrale Recensioni dei fogli con il CFO e il capo di FRA, guida allineamento sui rischi chiave, giudizi e azioni.

• I processi contabili internazionali e l'armonizzazione delle pratiche contabili in tutte le regioni.

• Condurre recensioni approfondite di bilancio critico e aree di rendita, identificare le opportunità per migliorare la coerenza, la trasparenza e il controllo.

• Allineare i processi regionali per sostenere la crescita, garantire un coordinamento efficace con i team regionali, le funzioni globali, i consolidamenti e il reporting e gli stakeholder interfunzionali.

• Rischio, Controlli e Governance

• Condurre e coordinare la risoluzione di argomenti contabili complessi e insoliti, collaborando con C&R e Global Technical Accounting per garantire l'allineamento.

• Formare le posizioni di riconoscimento dei ricavi regionali e l'allineamento del drive con Global Technical Accounting.

• Stabilire un solido quadro di identificazione del rischio e di governance, assicurando un'escalation tempestiva, una risoluzione e una mitigazione dei principali rischi contabili nei mercati.

• Partner chiave della funzione Controllo Interno per rafforzare i controlli sui mercati internazionali.

• Trasformazione digitale campione

• Membro chiave dell'organo di governo all'interno di FRA International per implementare l'uso responsabile delle capacità di automazione e intelligenza artificiale. Integra una cultura dell'innovazione, valutando continuamente strumenti e tecnologie emergenti per modernizzare la funzione FRA.

• Identificare e dare priorità alle opportunità di automatizzare i processi e sfruttare l'IA nelle attività di core accounting e reporting.

• Leader realizzazione di iniziative digitali collaborando con team interni e consulenti esterni, garantendo un'efficienza e un guadagno di qualità misurabili.

• People & Leadership organizzativa

• Collabora con i leader regionali di FRA/Finance per costruire una comunità di controllo di alto livello, concentrandosi sulla qualità, la responsabilità e la partnership aziendale.

• Dimostrare l'influenza (con o senza autorità) progettando e fornendo iniziative mirate come formazione IFRS, workshop tecnici e forum di condivisione delle conoscenze per migliorare la capacità e l'impegno.

• Guida l'adozione efficace e responsabile delle iniziative digitali, guidando miglioramenti scalabili, contribuendo attivamente agli sforzi di trasformazione interfunzionali.

The International Accounting and Reporting Director is a pivotal senior finance leadership role responsible for driving the strategic direction and strengthening governance of accounting and financial reporting across International markets. This role provides enterprise-wide oversight of IFRS and Alcon policy application, leading complex accounting decisions and ensuring consistency, transparency, and control at scale. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior regional and global stakeholders, the Director shapes key business decisions and drives financial integrity. With strong visibility to executive leadership, this position plays a critical role in advancing reporting excellence, driving digital transformation, and building organizational capability. It is a key successor role within the International Finance leadership pipeline, with significant ownership and influence over high-impact financial outcomes.

Leadership Expectations:

• Lead the evolution of FRA function into an International organization, scaling the team and operating model to support the growth of the region.

• Own and elevate stakeholder experience, delivering high-quality, reliable accounting outcomes and balance sheet reviews.

• Act as the single point of accountability (for Global Technical Accounting, International FRA Head, Consolidations and Reporting function) for key accounting and reporting decisions and risk management across regions.

• Champion digital transformation, advancing automation and innovation in accounting and reporting.

• Strengthen controller capability, partnering with regions to build a high-performing, future-ready finance talent bench.

In this role, a typical day will include:

• International Accounting & Reporting

• Lead quarterly International Balance Sheet reviews with the CFO and Head of FRA, driving alignment on key risks, judgments, and actions.

• Own key International Accounting processes and drive harmonization of accounting practices across regions.

• Conduct deep-dive reviews of critical balance sheet and income statement areas, identifying opportunities to enhance consistency, transparency, and control.

• Align regional processes to support growth, ensuring effective coordination with Regional teams, Global functions, Consolidations and Reporting, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Risk, Controls & Governance

• Lead and coordinate resolution of complex and unusual accounting topics, partnering with C&R and Global Technical Accounting to ensure alignment.

• Shape regional revenue recognition positions and drive alignment with Global Technical Accounting.

• Establish a robust risk identification and governance framework, ensuring timely escalation, resolution, and mitigation of key accounting risks across markets.

• Key partner to the Internal Controls function to strengthen controls across International markets.

• Champion Digital Transformation

• Key member of governance body within FRA International to implement responsible usage of automation and artificial intelligence capabilities. Embed a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and technologies to modernize the FRA function.

• Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate processes and leverage AI in core accounting and reporting activities.

• Lead implementation of digital initiatives by partnering with internal teams and external consultants, ensuring measurable efficiency and quality gains.

• People & Organizational Leadership

• Partner with regional FRA/Finance leaders to build a high-performing controller community, focusing on quality, accountability, and business partnership.

• Demonstrate influence (with or without authority) by design and delivering targeted initiatives such as IFRS training, technical workshops, and knowledge-sharing forums to enhance capability and engagement.

• Travel Expectations:

• Travel on a need basis. Current estimate: 30% travel in Year 1 with an expectation of reduced travel in the future.

Key Success Factors:

• Shape and influence critical accounting judgments, ensuring strong alignment with Global functions and Consolidations & Reporting (C&R).

• Drive consistent and robust accounting positions across the region, with particular focus on revenue recognition and key FSLIs.

• Lead the effective and responsible adoption of digital initiatives, driving scalable improvements while actively contributing to cross-functional transformation efforts.

• Own and lead International Balance Sheet governance, facilitating high-quality discussions with senior stakeholders to proactively identify risks and drive actions.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

Education:

• Chartered Accountant or CPA is a must.

Languages:

• Fluent English + other languages (mandarin or Japanese) a plus

Experience:

• Deep accounting expertise and business judgment, with 15+ years of experience across accounting, finance, internal controls, or advisory roles, and strong command of IFRS and complex accounting frameworks.

• Proven ability to shape and influence senior stakeholders, driving focused discussions with Finance leadership and enabling meaningful policy, structural business changes within the organization.

• Strong technical foundation with global perspective, including experience in Big 4 audit and/or Technical Accounting, and operating effectively within complex, multinational matrix environments.

• Track record of building high-performing teams, with demonstrated success in talent development, organizational leadership, and leading through transformation and change.

• Digital and systems acumen, with proficiency in SAP and other ERP platforms, and the ability to leverage technology to enhance efficiency, control, and insight.

• Exceptional communication and leadership presence, enabling effective collaboration, clear articulation of complex topics, and influence at all levels of the organization.

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:
● Manage your own workload and schedule while hitting your set targets
● Collaborate with teammates to share best practices and learnings as work evolves
● See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities

Mit einer starken Sichtbarkeit für Führungskräfte spielt diese Position eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Förderung der Berichterstattung, der Förderung der digitalen Transformation und dem Aufbau organisatorischer Fähigkeiten. • Meistern Sie die digitale Transformation, die Automatisierung und Innovation in Buchhaltung und Reporting.

• Führen Sie vierteljährliche internationale Bilanz Übersichten mit dem CFO und dem Leiter der FRA, um die Ausrichtung auf die wichtigsten Risiken, Urteile und Maßnahmen voranzutreiben.

• Eigene wichtige internationale Rechnungslegungsprozesse und fördern die Harmonisierung der Rechnungslegungspraktiken in allen Regionen.

Wir innovieren mutig, setzen uns für Fortschritt ein und agieren schnell als weltweit führendes Unternehmen in der Augenpflege. Hier werden Sie für Ihr Engagement und Ihre Beiträge anerkannt und sehen Ihre Karriere wie nie zuvor. Gemeinsam gehen wir weit darüber hinaus, um das Leben unserer Patienten und Kunden zu beeinflussen. Wir fördern eine integrative Kultur und suchen nach vielfältigen, talentierten Menschen, die Alcon beitreten.

Als Field Service Engineer (m/w/d) sind Sie für die Durchführung von Installationen, Notreparaturen, vorbeugenden Wartungen und die Durchführung von Nachrüstungen und Upgrades an chirurgischen Geräten von Alcon im zugewiesenen Gebiet in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus wird von Ihnen erwartet, dass Sie Servicevereinbarungen aushandeln, die dazu beitragen, die Verkaufsziele zu erreichen und zu übertreffen.

In dieser Rolle wird ein typischer Tag beinhalten:

• Führen Sie korrigierende und präventive Wartung, Nachrüstungen, Upgrades und Systeminstallationen durch.

• Etablieren und pflegen Sie ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit.

• Sofort auf Kundenanliegen, Qualitätssicherung und medizinische Sicherheitsfragen eingehen.

• Verwalten Sie den täglichen Zeitplan und pflegen Sie gleichzeitig eine genaue und zeitnahe Kommunikation mit Kunden, Versand, Managern, regionalen und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.

• Bewahren Sie alle administrativen Verantwortlichkeiten rechtzeitig und korrekt auf.

• Unterstützen Sie Sales, Clinical und In-House-Team einschließlich anderer Außendienstmitarbeiter bei Bedarf.

• Verwalten Sie das Inventar, führen Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen und geben Sie unbenutzte und ausgefallene Teile umgehend zurück.

• Förderung / Verkauf von Servicevertragsangeboten an Kunden und Unterstützung des Vertriebs beim Verkauf von Serviceverträgen an Kunden innerhalb des zugewiesenen Gebiets nach Bedarf.

WAS WIRST IHR ZU KONNEN:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder technische Ausbildung in Elektrotechnik, Mechanik, Biomedizin, Optik oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch

• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz (deutschsprachiger Teil)

• Gültiger Führerschein und Reisebereitschaft in der ganzen Schweiz

• Starke technische Fähigkeiten zur Fehlersuche und Problemlösung

• Erfahrung in der Wartung komplexer technischer Geräte, medizinischer Geräte, Laborgeräte oder industrieller Systeme

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig von einem Home Office und im Feld zu arbeiten

• Professionelle Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in kundenorientierten Umgebungen

NICE TO HAVE:

• Erfahrung mit medizinischen Geräten, chirurgischen Geräten oder Gesundheitstechnologie

• Kenntnisse der ophthalmologischen oder chirurgischen Systeme

• Erfahrung in Krankenhäusern oder Operationssälen

• Vorherige Erfahrung im Außendienst in einer kundenorientierten Rolle

WIE KÖNNEN SIE ZU ALKON KOMMEN:

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket mit Festgehalt und Bonus

• Ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit kompetenten und engagierten Kollegen. Wir arbeiten gerne auf gute und respektvolle Weise zusammen und feiern unsere gemeinsamen Erfolge

• Schulung in Systemen und Produkten

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Arbeitsplan an Ihre Bedürfnisse anzupassen - bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Rolle eine Feldrolle ist und die meiste Zeit (bis zu 80%) damit verbracht wird, Kunden zu reisen und zu besuchen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Alcon, nous sommes animés par le travail significatif que nous faisons pour aider les gens à voir brillamment. Nous innovons hardiment, défendons les progrès et agissons avec rapidité en tant que leader mondial des soins oculaires. Ici, vous serez reconnu pour votre engagement et vos contributions et voir votre carrière comme jamais auparavant. Ensemble, nous allons au-delà pour avoir un impact sur la vie de nos patients et de nos clients. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et sommes à la recherche de personnes diverses et talentueuses pour rejoindre Alcon.

En tant qu'ingénieur du Service mobile (h/f/d), vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la réparation d'urgence, de l'entretien préventif et de la mise à niveau de l'équipement chirurgical Alcon sur le territoire assigné en Suisse. De plus, on s'attend à ce que vous négociiez des ententes de service qui contribuent à atteindre et à dépasser les objectifs de vente.

Dans ce rôle, une journée typique comprendra:

• Effectuer l'entretien correctif et préventif, les rénovations, les mises à niveau et les installations du système.

• Établir et maintenir un niveau élevé de satisfaction de la clientèle.

• Répondez rapidement aux préoccupations des clients, à l'assurance de la qualité et aux questions de sécurité médicale.

• Gérer l'horaire quotidien tout en maintenant des communications précises et opportunes avec les clients, l'expédition, les gestionnaires, les équipes régionales et interfonctionnelles.

• Maintenir toutes les responsabilités administratives en temps opportun et avec exactitude.

• Aider les équipes de vente, clinique et interne, y compris d'autres représentants du Service mobile au besoin.

• Gérer l'inventaire, tenir des dossiers exacts et retourner rapidement les pièces inutilisées et défaillantes.

• Promouvoir/vendre des offres de services aux clients et aider les ventes à vendre des contrats de services aux clients sur le territoire assigné au besoin.

Ce que vous allez apporter à Alcon:

• Baccalauréat ou formation technique en génie électrique, mécanique, biomédical, optique ou un domaine connexe

• Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais

• Résidence en Suisse (partie germanophone)

• Permis de conduire valide et volonté de voyager dans toute la Suisse

• Fortes compétences techniques en résolution de problèmes

• Expérience de l'entretien des équipements techniques complexes, des dispositifs médicaux, des équipements de laboratoire ou des systèmes industriels

• Capacité de travailler indépendamment d'un bureau à domicile et sur le terrain

• Compétences en communication professionnelle dans les environnements orientés vers le client

C'est gentil d'avoir:

• Expérience des dispositifs médicaux, de l'équipement chirurgical ou de la technologie de santé

• Connaissance des systèmes ophtalmiques ou chirurgicaux

• Expérience de travail dans les hôpitaux ou le théâtre d'opération

• Expérience antérieure du service sur le terrain dans un rôle de client

Comment pouvez-vous faire à Alcon:

• Un salaire compétitif avec salaire fixe et bonus

• Un environnement de travail flexible avec des collègues compétents et engagés. Nous aimons travailler ensemble de manière bonne et respectueuse, et nous célébrons nos succès communs

• Formation aux systèmes et aux produits

• Possibilité d'adapter votre horaire de travail à vos besoins - veuillez noter que ce rôle est un rôle sur le terrain et la plupart du temps (jusqu'à 80%) seront dépensés voyage et visite clients
